description.en: A 4-week combo bundle: 500 on-net minutes, 25 on-net SMS, 25 off-net minutes, 25 off-net SMS, and 300 MB of data for 5,000 IQD.
description.ar: باقة كومبو لمدة 4 أسابيع: 500 دقيقة داخل الشبكة، 25 رسالة نصية داخل الشبكة، 25 دقيقة و25 رسالة خارج الشبكة، و300 ميغابايت انترنت مقابل 5,000 دينار عراقي.
description.ckb: پاکێجی کۆمبۆ بۆ ماوەی 4 هەفتە: 500 خولەک بۆ ناو تۆڕ، 25 نامەی کورت بۆ ناو تۆڕ، 25 خولەک و25 نامە بۆ دەرەوەی تۆڕ، لەگەڵ 300 مێگابایت ئینتەرنێت بە 5,000 دیناری عێراقی.
description.kmr: Pakêja Combo ji bo 4 hefteyan: 500 deqîqe di nav torê de, 25 SMS di nav torê de, 25 deqîqe û 25 SMS derveyî torê, û 300 MB înternet bi 5,000 dînarî.

subscribe.en: To subscribe, dial *123*1# or send COMBO to 1234.
subscribe.ar: للاشتراك، اطلب *123*1# أو أرسل COMBO إلى 1234.
subscribe.ckb: بۆ بەشداریکردن، *123*1# لێبدە یان COMBO بنێرە بۆ 1234.
subscribe.kmr: Ji bo aboneyê, *123*1# bigire yan COMBO bişîne bo 1234.

unsubscribe.en: To unsubscribe, send STOP COMBO to 1234, or dial *123# and choose Unsubscribe. There is no cancellation fee.
unsubscribe.ar: لإلغاء الاشتراك، أرسل STOP COMBO إلى 1234 أو اطلب *123# واختر إلغاء الاشتراك. لا توجد رسوم إلغاء.
unsubscribe.ckb: بۆ هەڵوەشاندنەوەی بەشداری، STOP COMBO بنێرە بۆ 1234 یان *123# لێبدە و هەڵوەشاندنەوە هەڵبژێرە. هیچ تێچوویەکی هەڵوەشاندنەوە نییە.
unsubscribe.kmr: Ji bo betalkirinê, STOP COMBO bişîne bo 1234 yan *123# bigire û Betalkirin hilbijêre. Xerca betalkirinê tune.

attributes.review_note: Seed entity built from the docs' worked example (docs/03 §5). Shortcodes (*123#, 1234) are INVENTED placeholders; ar/ckb/kmr text machine-drafted — confirm codes, numbers and translations before status:verified (docs/20/21). ⚠ RETIRED 2026-09-12. Reason: a usefulness probe found the invented placeholders ranking #1 on 6 of 24 realistic customer questions and in the top 3 on 11 of 24 — they outranked the 50 real FEBRA bundles because they were the only entities with BOTH aliases and how_to, so they were the richest documents in the index. Worst observed case: "how do I subscribe to Weekly TikTok?" returned bundle_1603 subscribe at fused score 1.00, offering the INVENTED code "dial *321*2# or send NET2 to 1234". The invented Shukran definition was also the material a 3B model borrowed to fabricate a definition of "Eshrat Omar". Retired rather than deleted so the record and the gold-set history survive; `status: retired` is excluded from every query by buildFilter(). To bring one back, author it from a real source and set status accordingly. Combo Bundle — facts came from the docs/03 worked example; the *123#/1234 shortcodes were INVENTED.
